title: Erdős Problem #824 under a smooth shifted-prime hypothesis
abstract: A Lean formalization of the conditional lower bound for the number h(x) of pairs of coprime positive integers a < b < x with equal sums of divisors. Assuming Hypothesis A⁺, which supplies sufficiently many primes p with smooth p+1, h(x) exceeds x^(2-ε) for every ε > 0 and all sufficiently large natural x. The argument adapts Pollack and Pomerance's finite counting method. A⁺ itself, the squarefree strengthening, and the accompanying paper's argument relying on the WD preprint are not formalized here.
